reviewers.agent: general-purpose subagent (Opus 4.8), separate context — independent judge, verified all 6 exporters + statsd/datadog key-collision

records.finding: The tracker emits the new biz_inflight_count family through the shared flush path, but NONE of the six export adapters handled it: five hard-error on the unknown family (dropping the ENTIRE metric batch — biz_inflight_value and counters too), and otlp silently mis-exported it as a monotonic counter delta. Any tracker+exporter deployment had broken in-flight metric export. The query side (memq/promql) was updated but the export side was missed.
records.evidence: prometheus/statsd/datadog/splunkhec/cloudwatch return 'unknown metric family'; otlp gaugeFamilies lacked biz_inflight_count.
records.reason: All six adapters now handle biz_inflight_count as a GAUGE (level): prometheus (new inflightCount GaugeVec, registered, name-qualified stale-guard key so it doesn't collide with biz_inflight_value's identical labels), otlp (gaugeFamilies), statsd (labelsFor + isGauge), datadog (familyTags + typ=gauge), splunkhec (familyFields), cloudwatch (dimsFor). testkit/conformance sampleMetrics now interleaves biz_inflight_count so every exporter's conformance suite exercises it — a durable regression guard for this whole class. Cross-examiner confirmed no exporter misclassifies the level and statsd/datadog have no value/count key collision.

records.finding: SLABreaches was split to use `breached` (past deadline, any policy) vs `breachedAndLost` (for ProjectedLostMinor value), so an at_risk breach counts toward SLABreaches but not projected loss — but no test exercised breached==true && breachedAndLost==false. The reference registry cannot produce one (its only at_risk stage, settle P1D, is unbreachable via the 120m top bucket).
records.evidence: No test entered the at_risk-breach branch.
records.reason: TestDeferredAtRiskBreachCountsButIsNotProjectedLost parses a custom flow (hold, at_risk, PT30M): a gt2h txn counts in SLABreaches (4) but not ProjectedLostMinor; Count=13. Confirms the split.

records.finding: The ADR claimed SLABreaches is 'now exact against the tracker's snapshot'. It is a conservative bucket-floor lower bound (like ProjectedLostMinor) and is structurally always 0 for a deadline beyond the top bucket floor (gt2h=120m), e.g. a P1D SLA. Count is exact; SLABreaches is not.
records.evidence: breached uses ageBucketFloorMinutes (gt2h=120m); a P1D deadline never registers.
records.reason: ADR now states Count is exact and SLABreaches is a conservative lower bound at bucket-floor granularity (the ADR-0005 tradeoff), with the P1D-unreachable example.

records.finding: biz_inflight_count was added to promql gaugeFamilies but no test pinned that promql translates it with last_over_time (gauge) rather than the counter cumulative-diff.
records.evidence: promql_test only covered biz_inflight_value for the gauge case.
records.reason: Added a promql test case asserting biz_inflight_count -> last_over_time gauge form.

records.finding: The count-unavailable caveat fires when value is present but no count series has count>0, so a source reporting value>0 with all-zero counts would trip it even though the count gauge is present.
records.reason: Unreachable for the real tracker (value and count come from one snapshot: value>0 implies count>0). Only a hand-fed inconsistent querier trips it; harmless and arguably correct disclosure. Cross-examiner concurred no guard is warranted.
